name: Block tracking & telemetry

description: Removes stream, pencil and markets ads from Yahoo Finance at the source so they are never fetched, loaded or shown.
name: Remove ads

description: Suppresses the 'Rate this app' prompt and the 'subscribe to Premium' upsell notification in the activity feed.
name: Remove nags

description: EXPERT USERS ONLY. Manually Configure It To Point At Real Splash And Main Activity As Many Apps Use Other Names. Check the log to know what the patch is doing. Ensure App Doesnt Ask For Permissions In Splash Screen.
name: Skip Splash Screen - Expert Only

options.description: Type just the class name, e.g. "SplashActivity" - no leading dot, it's added automatically. Leave blank to auto-detect the launcher activity and require it to score as a confident splash guess.
options.title: Splash activity name

options.description: Type just the class name, e.g. "MainActivity" - no leading dot, it's added automatically. Leave blank to auto-detect the app's own most main-screen-like activity.
options.title: Real main activity name

description: Closes the onboarding tips screen as soon as it opens.
name: Skip tips screen

description: By default, skips the splash screen entirely on launch. Turn on "Boost splash" to instead keep it briefly on screen (configurable delay) Useless To Boost Splash Screen If You Select Unlock Premium Patch Too Use If You Want To Skip Splash Screen Entirely
name: Skip/Boost splash screen

options.description: Off: splash is skipped entirely. On: splash briefly shows, then proceeds after the configured delay.
options.title: Boost splash instead of skipping

options.description: Only used when "Boost splash" is on. How long to show the splash before proceeding.
options.title: Boost delay (ms)

description: Applies Smart Enhance to every video at a level set in Mod Settings, and keeps it after lock/unlock.
name: Smart Enhance Always On

description: Replaces the Smart Enhance toggle with a 0-100% popup slider and keeps the level after lock/unlock.
name: Smart Enhance Slider

description: Enters the main activity directly after the splash screen.
name: Speed up splash screen

description: Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it, useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate. Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation. Apply with Original app certificate patch.
name: Spoof App Signature

options.description: Leave blank — read automatically from the app. Only set this if you changed the app's package name and the patch is using the wrong one.
options.title: Package name override (optional)

description: Forces SecurityTracker.isPremium() to always return true, so every feature gated by the "st_01" premium flag stays unlocked.
name: Unlock Premium

description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.
name: Unlock premium

description: Forces the purchase check to always return true, unlocking Pro.
name: Unlock Pro

description: Signature verification is spoofed automatically if this patch is selected the purchase check passes.
name: Unlock Pro

description: Unlocks Pro features.
name: Unlock Pro

description: Forces the Pro flag true at every read and write site in the dex, unlocking Pro.
name: Unlock Pro

description: Unlocks all pro features.
name: Unlock Pro

description: Forces the premium check to always return true, unlocking every Pro feature, and stops the in-app "rate us" dialog from ever triggering.
name: Unlock Pro & Disable Rate Dialog

description: Forces the ad-removed/Pro check to always return true, and renames the launcher activity from SplashActivity to MainActivity so the splash screen is skipped.
name: Unlock Pro & Skip Splash Screen

description: Replaces res/raw/hosts.txt with a text/host file you select.
name: Use Your Own Host File For Stronger AdBlock

options.description: Text/host file that replaces the built-in res/raw/hosts.txt.
options.title: Host file

description: Raises the volume boost limit in the player and background playback. Toggle in Mod Settings.
name: Volume Booster

description: Shows pure black and pure white as selectable Lawnchair color options.
name: Pure black and white color options

description: Adds persistent pure_black and pure_white color values to Lawnchair's color option parser.
name: Pure black and white color parsing

description: Removes the handle and its reserved area from the top of Lawnchair's app drawer.
name: Remove All Apps handle

description: Removes the handle spacing and remaining top padding from All Apps.
name: Remove All Apps handle spacing

description: Removes the obsolete All Apps bottom-sheet handle hit target.
name: Remove All Apps handle touch area

description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide recommendations

description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide sender names when forwarding

description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide sponsored proxy channel

description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide Stories

description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends

description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide time on stickers

description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Hide translate bar

description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Holiday look all year

description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: HushTelegram settings

description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Ignore mentions in muted chats

description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Keep deleted messages

description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Keep videos muted on volume keys

description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Message times with seconds

description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.
name: Open links externally

description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Play voice messages one at a time

description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Quiet contacts nag

description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Notifications.
name: Repair Firebase push registration

description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Reveal spoilers

description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Show user and chat IDs

description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Silence people outside your contacts

description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Start the camera on the rear lens

description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.
name: Strip link tracking

description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Swipe back on profiles

description: Telegram Beta always writes debug logs to your phone, its connection log included, and its own debug menu can't stop that. This stops them, so the beta only logs when you turn logs on in its debug menu. The regular telegram.org build doesn't force them, so nothing changes there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats, then restart Telegram.
name: Turn off beta debug logs

description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Turn off haptic feedback

description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Turn off reaction effects

description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chats.
name: Use normal paste

description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.
name: Use registered Maps API key

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).
options.title: Your Google Maps key

description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.
name: Use registered Telegram API credentials

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
options.title: Your API ID

options.description: The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.
options.title: Your API hash
